links.outcome: Triage accuracy of AI-enhanced chatbots versus existing rules-based chatbot on same vignettes
links.effect: Rules-based 71.8% (95% CI 56.2-83.5%) vs Dialogflow 30.8% (p = 0.002) and Gemini 41.0% (p = 0.031); Dialogflow, ChatGPT, Gemini statistically indistinguishable.
links.quote: The rules-based chatbot was most accurate (71.8%, 95% CI 56.2-83.5%), outperforming Dialogflow (30.8%, p = 0.002) and Gemini (41.0%, p = 0.031).

unlisted_practices: Evaluating tester preference alongside measured accuracy to detect conversational fluency masking poorer performance

screen.reason: Evaluates accuracy and user experience of integrating various AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Dialogflow) versus rules-based logic into a clinical triage chatbot using clinical vignettes.
